column7:

lakh was the net effect of increase of
`124.50 lakh, decrease by re-
appropriation of `124.50 lakh and
surrender of `373.50 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need of additional
amounts by officer-in-charge,
National Food Safety Mission Cell,
Bihar, Patna. Decrease by re-
appropriation was attributed to
anticipated saving. Surrender was
attributed to amendment in scheme
outlay. Reasons for non-utilisation of
the entire provision have not been
intimated (August 2023).
